You said: The double yellow lines and road markings on Masons Way have faded badly. That makes the parking rules hard to enforce, and the crossings near the Learning Campus less safe.
We did:
We've asked East Lothian Council's roads team to repaint them.
You can help: report the faded lines yourself through the council's Report It service (more reports carry more weight), and send us photos showing exactly where.

You said: Residents requested a pedestrian crossing be installed on Masons Way near the playpark
We did: ELC and the Developer have agreed to install a crossing and work should be underway soon

You said: Mud from the building site is being left all over Masons Way, making the road and pavements messy.
We did: We raised it with our contact at East Lothian Developments. It has been confirmed there is a cleaning process in place and we have been provided with the Site Managers contact details should any future issues occur.

You said: All the street lights on the new Wallyford Express path, between the Community Church and the school, are out.
We did: SP Energy Networks have replied to say there is no power supply to the lighting cabinet. This is now being investigated and SP Energy Networks are following up with East Lothian Council about who is responsible for the lighting infrastructure.

You said: Some of the drain covers on Masons Way need to be fixed.
We did: We've reported the drain covers to Scottish Water and are waiting for them to be repaired.

You said: Residents have asked for a new bus shelter at the stop on Salters Road at St Clements Wells
We did: We've passed the request to East Lothian Council and are waiting for a reply.

You said: The community council needs to be better at communicating with residents.
We did: We've been posting more updates on Facebook and have opened some posts up for comments. We also built this website, so you can see what we're working on and how it's going.

You said: There is a broken light at the Miners Stone
We did: This has been raised with East Lothian Council and we have established that the fixture needs to be repaired or replaced. We are now seeking help from an electrician to check if the light can be repaired on needs replaced.
